text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first progress presentation. 
The Shinme will showcase the fruits of 
their practice so far 
in the very venue where the main event 
will take place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the audience, instructors and 
horsegirls 
who assisted with the workshops and 
training camp watched on.
choice_data_list: (I want to give them peace of mind, too.)

(I really hope we can put their minds at 
ease.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want them to see that the Shinme, led by 
<chrname> as Shinshime, 
can be trusted to take charge of our 
festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...That is what I hope to prove to them.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. 
Are you feeling nervous too?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just like Boo, then! 
Boo's a little nervous too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. Boo is gonna nail 
this! 
Relax, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You can already picture 
how Boo's gonna leap, can't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I believe in you. You've got this.
Yep, I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! 
Boo feels the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first progress presentation 
began!
